observation.summary: The Drive-side title invariant passed on a synthetic Doc: the Drive file title exactly matched the first visible HEADING_1, but Gemini's export action was unavailable.
observation.expected_state: Gemini export creates a Drive Doc whose file title equals DOCUMENT_TITLE and its first visible H1.
observation.observed_state: Drive title equaled the first visible H1; the Gemini export stage itself was not executed.

classification.rationale: No Gemini execution connector/runtime was available, so the Drive-side invariant is observed without promoting the full Gemini-to-Drive export path.

evidence.supports: Durable follow-up records the matching Drive title/H1 observation and explicitly names the unavailable Gemini execution stage.
Merged P123 document-identity contract remains the implementation floor for this field probe.
